welcome.transcript: Welcome to the Feelings Theatre. Choose a feeling for Teddy to try.

ready.transcript: When the light glows, say I can do it.

mic-fallback.transcript: That is okay. Tap the sparkling star while you say the line.

quiet-nudge.transcript: I'm listening. Bring your voice a little closer.

happy-model.transcript: Happy Voice? I can do it now. Show me your bright bouncy voice.

proud-model.transcript: Proud voice, I can do it. Now stand tall and use your strong steady voice.

calm-model.transcript: Calm voice. I can do it. Now breathe in and use your soft smooth voice.

silly-model.transcript: Silly voice? I can do it! Boing boing! Now make your funniest wiggly voice!

proud-success.transcript: That voice sounded strong and proud.

complete.transcript: Bravo! Your voice brought every feeling to life.
